title: Sequential versus Gather
statement: Implement `solve(a, b)`. Both are non-negative durations. Return `{"sequential": a+b, "concurrent": the max of a and b}`. Negative inputs return `error`.
constraints: Concurrent time is the slower call

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Awaiting two coroutines one after another adds their waits.

editorial: Awaiting two coroutines one after another adds their waits. gather overlaps them, so the wall time is the slower one, plus a little scheduling you can ignore here. The two numbers are the reason to gather independent I/O.
